name: ExampleABC - Batches03-04 Follow-up Preview - READ ONLY

parameters.content:
## Follow-up review, no sending

Reads Prospects, Email Drafts and the dedicated Batch34 Followup Log. Produces 16 candidates with verified original Gmail IDs and templates. Does NOT reply to any messages or write any Sheets data. Explicitly excludes known bounces/unmonitored/ineligible prospects. Additional live thread checks and final user approval required.
